name: Messages

landlock_rules.kernel_note: INTENT ONLY: Landlock is not available on Linux 4.14 (requires >= 5.13).

network_policy.kernel_note: cgroup v1 net_cls classid 16973826 = 0x01030002 on Linux 4.14.

enforcement.apparmor: profile configs/apparmor.d/usr.bin.nuxel-messages; only effective if the AppArmor LSM is enabled in this kernel
enforcement.note: SMS send/receive runs through Radio1 over IMS (Radio1 vtable behind nl.nuxel.Radio1Bridge). The CS SMS path is denied on LTE-only. Messages is not wrapped by nuxel-sandbox, so no cgroup rule applies.

note: Messages is started by the Home launcher as the session user via the registry native_binary (/usr/bin/nuxel-messages), not through this cgroup profile. The SMS transport is Radio1, reached through the system-bus bridge nl.nuxel.Radio1Bridge.
